actions.ownerRole: Customer product engineer; privacy reviewer reviews evidence
actions.deliverable: Proposed removal of optional third-party code from the fictional sensitive entry plus a bounded entry-network retest record.
actions.acceptance: For the same supplied revision, inspect the empty synthetic R02 entry in a clean browser context; record request destination categories and storage behavior without payloads, queries, answers or results. Optional third-party requests on this sensitive entry must be absent. Record browser/version and limitations. No claim about uninspected result or other routes.
actions.remaining: Privacy claims, other sensitive-route coverage and any qualified determination need separate evidence; a recommendation is not a repair.

actions.ownerRole: Customer product lead; authorized rights holder decides permissions
actions.deliverable: Proposed exact-version rights-source register, without questionnaire items.
actions.acceptance: Request the authoritative owner/publisher source naming exact version, intended use and limits. Record checked date and unresolved restrictions. Retain information-only handling while permission is unresolved; check both R02 and R03 entry boundaries. A validation paper is not a rights grant.
actions.remaining: No owner source or permission was supplied; qualified interpretation and rights-holder decisions remain outside this sample.

actions.ownerRole: Customer content lead; topic-qualified clinician reviews supplied copy
actions.deliverable: Request a non-sensitive copy artifact and appropriate source/qualified-review record; this is a proposal only.
actions.acceptance: Record the supplied copy artifact revision and whether source-aligned non-diagnostic wording and each relevant branch have qualified review. Keep approval UNKNOWN without that review. Inspect only R02 entry limitations within this engagement; do not answer an assessment or open results to verify the inherited narrative.
actions.remaining: Result wording is inherited invented narrative, not a personal observation. Artifact, specialist review and result-state verification are unperformed.

actions.ownerRole: Customer accessibility engineer; specialist reviews remaining gaps
actions.deliverable: Proposed entry keyboard/focus check and separate generic synthetic-control evidence request.
actions.acceptance: For R02 entry, record keyboard reachability, accessible names and visible focus. Request a separate generic synthetic radio-control fixture for selected-state semantics and target-size evidence; do not administer a screener. The sample's 44 CSS-pixel target is a design target, not a universal WCAG rule. Record browser, viewport and assistive technology used or UNTESTED.
actions.remaining: No manual screen-reader, keyboard or formal conformance assessment has occurred. Automated checks alone cannot certify conformance.

decisionRules.missingOrStaleEvidence: Observation time/current applicability UNKNOWN; recheck exact source revision. Preparation time is not observation time.
decisionRules.partialCoverage: Uncovered required routes remain unverified; no full closure. Broken or duplicate references require correction before accepting a handoff claim.
decisionRules.scopeChange: A sixth route, second family, remediation or deployment is outside this fixed review. Isolate a proposal; no implicit acceptance, action or billing.
decisionRules.commercialGate: Private sample completion permits no sale or launch. Accepted scope, terms, payment/delivery arrangements and relevant specialist/owner decisions remain separate.
